[[Count zu Heltzer]] wishes you to assist the [[Kurzick]]s in capturing the jade mines at [[the Jade Quarry]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Travel to [[The Jade Quarry (Kurzick)|the Jade Quarry]] and speak to [[Kommandant Durheim]].

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Starting from House zu Heltzer, head southeast through [[Ferndale]] to reach [[Lutgardis Conservatory]]. Then proceed northeast through [[Melandru's Hope]], and eventually you will reach your destination. Talk to Kommandant Durheim for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Count zu Heltzer
:''"As you know, we Kurzicks make many of our fine instruments, sculptures, and weapons from jade mined from [[the Jade Sea]]. This wouldn't be such a problem if not for those barbaric [[Luxon]]s. They actually have the audacity to claim that the Jade Sea and all its resources are theirs alone. By what right, I ask you? None! None at all. We have begun an operation to recover some jade, and we could use your help.''

:''Will you travel to the '''Jade Quarry''' and lend '''Kommandant Durheim''' your assistance?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I will go to the Jade Quarry.
|decline = I'm no miner.
|ask = Travel to the '''Jade Quarry''' and help us liberate the jade from the Luxons. Seek out '''Kommandant Durheim''' when you get there. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Kommandant Durheim
:''"Count zu Heltzer sent you? Very good, we can use all the help we can get."''
